'''Torch''' was the [[astromech droid]] companion of [[rebel pilot]] and later [[Resistance pilot]] [[Venisa Doza]]. He accompanied her on many missions, including to the [[Planet|worlds]] [[Bakura]] and [[Rakata Prime|Lehon]].<ref name="Rendezvous Point" /> During one of the initial training sessions that Venisa gave her daughter, [[Torra Doza|Torra]], as a [[starfighter]] [[pilot]], Torra ejected Torch from his [[astromech socket]]. Torch was good friends with [[Jarek Yeager]]'s astromech, [[R1-J5|Bucket]].<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" />

When Torch and Venisa were captured along with their [[Venisa Doza's X-wing|X-wing]] by [[Agent]] [[Tierny]] of the [[First Order]], the [[droid]] pretended to have been fried and rendered inoperable in order to assist in Doza's [[Escape of Venisa Doza|escape]] from the agent's [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Thunderer]]'', piloting a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]] out of the [[capital ship]]'s main [[hangar]] as a diversion before ejecting from it with his [[rocket booster]]s to rejoin Venisa on her [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|X-wing]].<ref name="Rendezvous Point" />

With their [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]], the pair later participated in running the [[blockade of Dantooine]]<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" /> and [[Battle of Barabesh|rescuing]] [[Tamara Ryvora]] as part of [[Jade Squadron]].<ref name="Escape">{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Torch first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' episode "[[Rendezvous Point (episode)|Rendezvous Point]]."<ref name="Rendezvous Point" /> In the episode's original outline, the astromech's name was "Scorch," but it was later changed to "Torch." Along with Doza's [[Venisa Doza's X-wing|X-wing]], Torch was designed to look as though Doza had owned him since the period of the Original Trilogy, as she'd been a fighter pilot from a young age.<ref name="Original Name">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-rendezvous-point-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Rendezvous Point" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref>
